s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Outside Moulding LH

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape around the moulding.
Heat the moulding using an infrared lamp or equivalent.
Set piano wire in the Mighty Puller.
Cut the double-sided tape adhesive with the piano wire and remove the front door outside moulding.

atten3.ptxt: When reusing the moulding, keep the Mighty Puller as close to the body as possible, and do not damage the ends of the moulding.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Outside Moulding LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear door outside moulding LH in the same way as the front door outside moulding LH.
